name: Should I build a room addition or remodel my existing space?

mainEntity.name: Should I build a room addition or remodel my existing space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between a room addition and remodeling depends on your specific goals and current home structure. A room addition is ideal when you need significantly more square footage and want to create entirely new dedicated spaces, like an extra bedroom or a larger kitchen. Remodeling, on the other hand, focuses on improving the functionality and aesthetics of your existing rooms without expanding the footprint. Consider your space needs, budget, and desired outcome when making this choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an addition for more square footage and new spaces; remodel for improving existing room functionality.
